verdict.rationale: Scheduled or recurring runs, such as periodic plan or drift checks, are a fair question for infrastructure-as-code tools, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows OpenTofu shipping any scheduling, cron, or recurring-workflow capability. Its documented features are on-demand CLI commands (plan, apply, test, import), and the 'automate your development workflow' claim refers to managing GitHub repositories as code, not scheduling jobs.
